- Check the FAQ in Private Table for more details

notes.title: Update 01 : Invite friends to Table, Casino Slot and Daily Streak
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/c5cca617443d1baef2dc61975a7ab4720d7a01c4.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone,
As per popular demand, in this update we have added an option to [b]invite your friends to table[/b] as well as some other in-game features. We believe this will further enhance your Downtown Casino poker experience. 

Features coming with [b]Update - 01[/b] are : 
[list]
[*] Casino Slots
[*] Daily Streak
[*] In-game Invite
[/list]

Stay tuned for other features which will be coming soon to Downtown Casino!
[olist]
[*][h1] Casino Slots[/h1]

Spend a slot Chip and try to get a combination and test your luck (Get 5 free slot chips daily). You can access the slots by clicking on slots button as shown in the image below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/20fddbf8884fb888963468d176e07682e20dd5f4.jpg[/img]

And here's what you get once you press the button

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/d560c217eca0a2319c7f04876f904ca941d52697.png[/img]

Give it a try and win free chips and possibly the progressive jackpot worth more than a million chips (if you are lucky enough !!)

[*][h1] Daily Streak[/h1]

We believe that our players need some extra chips as they spend quite a lot challenging and trying their best against other poker sharks. 
So we introduced Daily Streak which will gift you chips (per 24 hours)depending upon your [b]on-going streak[/b]. That is, the reward increases as you play consecutive days which we call a growing streak. 
The steak is broken when a days streak reward is not collected by the player and it will be rested to day -1. So again you have to build up the streak. 

Whenever you play Downtown Casino, you will be greeted with the Daily Streak UI as given below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/c2ef759a3bf98806ca221bcdee99e6564b448658.jpg[/img]

When you claim the reward, it will show your streak and how much you earned as a gift.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/e997bf41965dd9665d3bc533af4eb04b26ba64bd.jpg[/img]

[b]Keep your streak going and see how high you can go!![/b]

[*][h1] In-game Invite[/h1]
 
Invite your friends from steam to a table that you are playing in to have fun together. Also, make buddies and earn referral bonuses and much more as you build your poker buddies list and invite others

[h1]How do I invite my friends?[/h1]

You can invite any player from your steam friends list to the table. The only condition is that you must be playing or spectating a table to invite others. When you are at a table, you will now see an icon as shown below :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/978783e0d054261d6c259c8e21e4de3de008ff98.jpg[/img]

Click on this icon and it will open up an in-game overlay with the list of your friends in steam. Also, the overlay will specify to which table you are inviting your friends to.
The overlay will be as shown below :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/3870595dc382d0400d587837eb95f4e179690ac8.png[/img]

Now select the friends you wish to invite by clicking on their profile, or you could click on send all to send the invite to all your friends in Steam. Once selected and the send button is pressed and if it succeeds, a popup will come up mentioning the names of the friends you have invited to the table. Just like as shown in the image below :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/ac5fa94feea6679a358c539338c9fdf09bcf57c9.jpg[/img]

Only the first 50 friends from a players steam friends list are shown due to limit a limit in the in-game mechanics. If your friend's name is not listed, use the search box and type his/her name and as you type the game will auto-fetch those particular player/players. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/002490c0d6fde774429085c9aa586a67911a874c.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/d274714c3f1c13b712028fc8fa3fd9f4111f3edd.jpg[/img]

So that's pretty much how you can invite your friends to the table. 

[h1]How will I know If I got an Invite?[/h1]

Whenever a player invites you to the game you are notified in two ways. They are as given below :
[list]
[*][b] Table Invite Popup [/b]

The moment a player invites you to the table, this popup slides in to notify you who invited you (name and player avatar are shown), the invited table name and the blinds of that respective table. 
It would be as shown below : 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/549854f4c6257f7b59e65ea63849293887a4f3f6.jpg[/img]

Click on the [b]VISIT TABLE[/b] button to join the respective table that particular player is playing.

[*][b] Notification [/b]

All the invites you received are sorted out and shown in the notification overlay. You can access it by clicking on the bell icon in the game. Please check the image given below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/32a4bb25750d941575ea6662cceb51fbada20176.jpg[/img]

Once you click the notification button, an overlay slides in showing you the details of your in-game activity. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/e944e6ba90e249a8fae1987343ca11f531cea1a1.png[/img]

Click on [b]Go[/b] button to join the table immediately.
  
[/list]

[h1]What happens once I accept an Invite?[/h1]

Accepting an invite can be related to the player responding positively to an invitation or invite notification. 

Once a player accepts an invite, He/she will join that particular table as a spectator and will be able to see the game happening there. If he/she wishes to play in that table, click on [b]JOIN[/b] button and a seat will be granted provided the table is not full. 

Also, the invitee and the player who sent the invite will be added as buddies in the Downtown casino and can earn a referral bonus(if a player is playing for the first time). 

Players won't be able to join a table if:-
[list]
[*] Table is full
[*] Player level is too low for the table
[*] Not enough cash to join the table
[/list]

Here's a preview of a table with a player who is spectating the on-going game :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/35463fd4c1ee56663183c4b7736c562f7045ac26.png[/img]

Ideal, if you want to see how others play or even learn a thing or two about poker tricks.

[h1]What if I am not playing the game and someone invites?  [/h1]

In such scenarios, the invitee gets a Steam invite as shown below:-

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/7adfbc4c396da363aacf1d208433a42f0833cdda.png[/img]

Once you click on the steam invite, you will get another popup stating Downtown Casino is attempting to launch with optional parameters, as shown below :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/23654c578b610221ca28e748ee84b9d9a14ad8c5.png[/img]

Click on "[b]OK[/b]" and the game will launch. After loading, you will get an invite popup as well as the notification which you can respond to join your friend's table. Also, [b]if the invitee is new to the game, you will get a referral bonus and invitee will be added to your buddy list automatically.[/b] 

[h1]Note[/h1] [list][*]You will still get steam game invites even if you are in-game. These invites won't have any functionality other than just alerting you to the presence of incoming notification.
[*]The launch parameters of Downtown Casino are completely safe. It is used to guide the game client to the respective table the invitee sends an invite for.
[/list] 
[/olist]
Feel free to use our community forums to share your ideas and suggestions!

[h1]Thank you for playing Downtown Casino![/h1]

notes.title: Poker Buddies & Daily Gifts !!
notes.notes:
Here's a small guide on Poker buddies and sending/receiving gifts among your buddies!

[h1][b]How to share buddy codes and let others add you as a buddy?[/b][/h1]

Its relatively easy to add buddies without copy/pasting buddy codes.
Heres how :- 
[b]
Step 1. Click on your friends avatar. It will now show an overlay with basic details of that user and few chat options to talk to that player in-game. Now click on his avatar in the overlay. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/651df4025431cb76fe633a10c742687b3daba47d.jpg[/img]

[b]Step 2. Once you click on the avatar shown in basic info overlay, you will get an overlay shown like this as shown below [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/6f05785a5b32bab8f186284dc4ed1541da9cf45e.jpg[/img]

This overlay now has much more details of players in-game stats. 

[b]Step 3. Click on "Wall". Now you can see an option to post your mob code on that player's wall. As shown in the picture below. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/a45b24f51a9c46be041e624b15563e0c83ae5f57.jpg[/img]

Now your buddy code will be posted to the corresponding player's wall and he/she will be notified about it. 

This is how it will look like once you post your buddy code 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/5eedc2e0888c1689b399ff9ca8f771905d2b2d6d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]How to add others as your buddy ?[/b][/h1]

So by now, you will be receiving many buddy code post on your profile wall. It's time to add them to your list of buddies with just an easy method.

Your wall will look like as shown below once someone posts their buddy code. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/de9e0836f1e40b955ca6e3c5d088d546232a657a.jpg[/img]

To add that player as a buddy, [b]simply press the "use code" highlight near the buddy code[/b] and that's it !!

[h1][b] We are buddies , so what now ? [/b][/h1]

So you made few buddies and the list is growing day by day. The good thing about being a buddy is that [b]you get to send free chips to your buddies and they can do the same to you [/b]as well. Isn't it generously overwhelming ?!?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/a1e4636360f0f6acb0f6a22d42792e745a99d2cd.jpg[/img]

Players whom you add as buddies in Downtown Casino is able to gift you chips once per day! So add as many poker buddies as you can!

Here's how to open the gifts tab. 

[b] Step 1. Click on the "buddies" button which will open the buddies overlay. In the overlay click on "Gifts". Now it will show you all the friends who gifted your poker chips. Click on collect to collect the gift! [/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/a4902f3b83ab3da4800311dae760955c14fb3d0b.jpg[/img]

Once you click on the "Collect" button, it shows you how much chips you got as the gift. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400370/e0c8d83a9618559a6f2f4301dc078b0806765e28.jpg[/img]


[h1] Now enjoy making buddies and become a real poker champ !!
[/h1]
